question.para: Both UNIX and UDP type of socket can be used to notify the events?

answer.para: Yes, you can use the both types.

question.para: What is the maximum lenght of a datagram event?

answer.para: The maximum length of a datagram event is 65457 bytes.

question.para: Where can I find more about OpenMarinkaRodeo?
Where can I post a question about this module?

answer.para: First at all check if your question was already answered on one of our mailing lists:
E-mails regarding any stable &oMarinkaRodeo; release should be sent to &oMarinkaRodeousersmail; and e-mails regarding development versions should be sent to &oMarinkaRodeodevmail;.
If you want to keep the mail private, send it to &oMarinkaRodeohelpmail;.

question.para: How can I report a bug?

answer.para: Please follow the guidelines provided at: &oMarinkaRodeobugslink;.
